title: DA3408 A4 · CPU Image Captioner — Observability
description: Health → golden signals → pipeline → clients → host for the BLIP Streamlit app. Orange bands mark bulk ZIP jobs.

options.content:
### How to read this dashboard
Read **top → bottom**: ① is the service up? → ② is it fast and correct (golden signals)? → ③ where does the time go inside the pipeline? → ④ who is using it? → ⑤ what does it cost the host? **Orange shaded bands = a bulk ZIP job was running** (annotation), so you can see bulk uploads line up with CPU, latency and queue spikes. Hover any graph: the crosshair is shared across panels. Colours: Okabe-Ito (colour-blind safe); series also differ by **line style** (solid / dashed / dotted) and show point markers so they survive greyscale print. Every x-axis is wall-clock time (browser timezone, 5 s scrape, 5 s refresh). Single-mode is always **blue solid**, bulk-mode always **orange dashed**.

panels.title: ① Service health — is it up?
App /metrics
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of the Streamlit app (:8000). UP = last scrape succeeded.

panels.title: node_exporter
panels.description: Scrape status of node_exporter (:9100); host metrics in ⑤ depend on it.

panels.title: BLIP model
panels.description: 1 when the captioning model is loaded in RAM and ready.

panels.title: App uptime
panels.description: Time since the app process started (resets on restart).

panels.title: Image error ratio (5 m)
panels.description: Share of images that failed (corrupt / unreadable) in the last 5 minutes. Green < 5 %, orange < 10 %, vermillion ≥ 10 % (alert threshold).

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(captioner_images_processed_total{status="error"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(rate(captioner_images_processed_total[5m])), 1e-9)) and on() (up{job="caption_app"} == 1) or on() ((up{job="caption_app"} == 1) * 0) or on() ((up{job="caption_app"} == 0) - 1)

panels.title: Images captioned
panels.description: Successful captions since app start (single + bulk).

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Distinct browser sessions active in the last 5 minutes (gauge).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules currently firing (see monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml).

panels.title: ② Golden signals — traffic, latency, errors
Throughput — images captioned per second
panels.description: Story: bulk jobs push throughput to ~1–1.5 img/s (the CPU ceiling for BLIP-base); single uploads appear as short blips. x: time · y: images/s (linear).

panels.title: Requests per minute by outcome
panels.description: One request = one single upload or one whole ZIP. success / error (unreadable image or failed ZIP) / rejected (not a ZIP or no images). x: time · y: requests in the trailing 1 min (linear).

panels.title: Inference latency per image — p50 / p95 / p99 / mean
panels.description: Model generate() time only. Story: p50 stays near the single-image cost; p95/p99 rise with large images and concurrent sessions. Log₂ y-axis so the ×2 steps are visible. x: time · y: seconds (log₂).

panels.title: Inference latency distribution (histogram buckets)
panels.description: Each column is one time step; each cell counts images whose inference time fell in that bucket (increase of captioner_inference_seconds_bucket). Brighter = more images. Colour scale: Viridis (perceptually uniform, colour-blind safe). x: time · y: bucket upper bound in seconds (ordinal).

panels.title: End-to-end request duration p95 — single vs bulk
panels.description: Whole request: one image for single, the entire ZIP for bulk. 5 m window because bulk requests are rare. Log₁₀ axis: single (~1 s) and bulk (~1 min) differ by ~2 orders of magnitude. x: time · y: seconds (log₁₀).

panels.title: Errors since app start — by stage and exception
panels.description: Counter totals of captioner_errors_total. decode = unreadable image, unzip = invalid archive, inference = model failure. Bar length: number of errors.

panels.title: ③ Inside the pipeline — concurrency, time breakdown, inputs
Concurrency — in-flight requests, model queue, bulk backlog
panels.description: Gauges. The model runs one image at a time (lock); when two sessions caption at once the queue depth rises. Bulk backlog (right axis) counts down as a ZIP is processed. x: time · y-left: requests / images waiting (linear) · y-right: images left (linear).

panels.title: Where the time goes — mean seconds per image by stage (stacked)
panels.description: Mean of each stage's histogram (rate(_sum)/rate(_count)), stacked so the top edge is the total per-image cost. Story: inference dominates; queue wait appears only under concurrent sessions; preprocessing is negligible. x: time · y: seconds (linear, stacked).

panels.title: Mean caption length (Summary)
panels.description: From the Summary captioner_caption_length_words: rate(_sum)/rate(_count). x: time · y: words per caption (linear).

panels.title: Upload bandwidth by mode
panels.description: Bytes received from clients per second (counter captioner_upload_bytes_total). A ZIP lands as one spike at upload time. x: time · y: bytes/s (linear, IEC).

panels.title: Mean input resolution
panels.description: Histogram captioner_image_megapixels: rate(_sum)/rate(_count). Bigger inputs cost more decode/resize time (not inference — BLIP resizes to 384²). x: time · y: megapixels (linear).

panels.title: Bulk jobs by outcome (since start)
panels.description: success = all images captioned, partial = some unreadable, failed = none, rejected = not a ZIP / no images, aborted = browser closed mid-job.

panels.title: ZIP entries skipped before inference (since start)
panels.description: Members filtered out of uploaded ZIPs: hidden/__MACOSX, non-image extension, > 25 MB, or over the per-job limit.

panels.title: Bulk job averages (Summary, since start)
panels.description: Means from Summaries: images per job = bulk_job_images_sum/_count; seconds per job = bulk_job_seconds_sum/_count.

panels.title: Model parameters
panels.description: Gauge set at load time.

panels.title: Model weights in RAM
panels.description: params × bytes per param (float32 = 4 B).

panels.title: Model load time
panels.description: Wall time to load processor + weights at startup.

panels.title: torch CPU threads
panels.description: Intra-op threads (half the logical CPUs by default; TORCH_THREADS env).

panels.title: ④ Who is using it — client tracking (custom labels)
Per-client activity since app start
panels.description: Built from the client_ip and session_id labels. Requests = uploads (single or ZIP); Images = successfully captioned images; Failed = error + rejected requests (error + rejected). Sorted by images.

panels.title: Requests by client IP and mode (since start)
panels.description: Same counter, aggregated by the client_ip label only.

panels.title: ⑤ Host resources (node_exporter) — correlated with application load
Correlation — host CPU busy % vs captioning throughput
panels.description: The key correlation: CPU (left axis, vermillion solid) rises in lock-step with images/s (right axis, blue dashed) and sits on a plateau during orange bulk bands. x: time · y-left: % of all cores busy (linear, 0–100) · y-right: images/s (linear).

panels.title: Host CPU by mode (stacked)
panels.description: Where CPU time goes: user (model math), system (kernel), iowait (disk). x: time · y: % of all cores (linear, stacked, 0–100).

panels.title: Captioning process CPU vs machine capacity
panels.description: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total) = CPU cores the app process is using. Compare with torch threads and total logical cores. x: time · y: cores (linear).

panels.title: Memory — host used vs captioning app RSS
panels.description: Story: the app's resident memory (~2 GB: BLIP weights + torch runtime) is a large, flat share of host RAM; bulk jobs add little because images are processed one at a time. x: time · y: bytes (linear, IEC).

panels.title: System load average vs cores
panels.description: Runnable + uninterruptible tasks averaged over 1 and 5 min. Load above the core count means CPU saturation. x: time · y: tasks (linear).

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes/s read and written across physical disks. Model load at startup is a read spike. x: time · y: bytes/s (linear, IEC).

panels.title: Network throughput — physical NICs vs loopback
panels.description: Uploads from local browsers travel over loopback (lo); remote clients over the NIC. x: time · y: bytes/s (linear, IEC).

panels.title: Root filesystem used
panels.description: 1 − avail/size for '/'. Green < 80 %, orange < 90 %, vermillion ≥ 90 %. Matters because the HF model cache and Prometheus TSDB live on this disk.
